name: AiChatDrawer
title: Blocks/Ai/AiChatDrawer
summary: The generative AI assistant in a right-side drawer over a resource page, so the reader asks about what they are looking at without leaving it: a workload page (`PageHeader` with an Agent `Button`, the name the console header gives the assistant, a `Card` of `KeyValuePairs` with a `StatusIndicator`) beside a medium `Drawer` with `:modal="false"` (no overlay), so the page stays undimmed and readable whose `PanelHeader` holds `DrawerTitle`, a Preview `Tag`, New chat and the drawer's own close button. Inside, an `EmptyState` with support prompts about this workload (`SuggestionGroup`), then a `Conversation` with every message at the inline start, responses that think (`Reasoning`), stream (`StreamingResponse`), cite (`Sources`) and carry Copy, Regenerate and feedback, and a `PromptInput` pinned at the foot with the disclaimer. Built from `Drawer`, `DrawerContent`, `DrawerTitle`, `PanelHeader`, `ChatMessage`, `Conversation`, `PromptInput`, `IconButton` and `CopyButton`. A page body for ConsoleLayout, rendered in its default slot; inside ConsoleLayout on a wide screen the same conversation can go in the layout's tools region (`v-model:tools-open`) instead.
intents: asistente de ia en panel lateral

variants.name: Streaming
variants.summary: The drawer open on a response streaming in about the 502 errors of the workload behind it, with the caret, Stop in the composer and the busy region.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: A response that failed mid-stream inside the drawer: the partial text, the error line and Try again.

variants.name: LongThread
variants.summary: Six earlier turns about the workload in the narrow drawer: the log opens on the newest response and Scroll to the latest message returns after scrolling up.
